featured_reviews.name: Avni Rathod
featured_reviews.review_text: Very good hospital. My husband recently got admitted for kidney stone removal. There are very good doctors in all field. All sisters and nurses are also well mannered. Mediclaim facility also available.

featured_reviews.name: Laura
featured_reviews.review_text:
Quick service at X-rays and pathology. Dr Avya Bansal was great too and quickly suspected the cause and found the solution for the health issue.
However, the toilets are not clean and have no toilet paper. The phlebotomy nurse didn’t disinfect her hands before taking my blood, which made me question overall standards of practice and hygiene in the hospital, which should be the main priority at any hospital.

featured_reviews.name: nrutish madhavi
featured_reviews.review_text: Medicines at the hospital's pharmacy are very expensive. After giving the prescription, patients are told to come back after half an hour or an hour.  Outside pharmacies offer a 10% to 15% discount. When we ask them for a discount, they say that being in the general ward itself is our discount. If it's going to take an hour, they should tell us to get the medicines from outside, but they don't do anything like that.

featured_reviews.name: Ashford Menezes
featured_reviews.review_text: I had a very unpleasant experience on my recent visit to the hospital. I was experiencing severe back ache and went to get an X-ray, while I first went to the counter I was quoted me Rs. 1550/- I agreed to go ahead with it and was directed to meet the CMO on duty on 1st April 2025 at around 8am in the morning. The CMO sitting across the counter quizzed like a general staff rather than examine me and diagnose me as would a doctor. I got the note and went to pay the agreed fee but was then told the pricing giving is wrong and therefore the new price is Rs. 1750/- which was wrong at all levels. I went ahead as I was in pain The technician in charge was considerate, when done with the imaging procedure, I came out and went to meet the CMO who very arrogantly refused to check the film and sarcastically told me to go to my GP simply because I did mention the same which is probably also against the medical practice. I was born in the new wing of Bombay Hospital and it then boasted of the best medical practice, but this experience has left me with unpleasant memories and I would advocate perhaps going to the local Government hospital nearby rather than this Hospital which treats its patients as if they are doing them a favour.

featured_reviews.name: kshitij yadav
featured_reviews.review_text: The front desk management team of Dr. Satish Khadilkar doesn't follow any token system of any sorts and just asks you to wait even after the appointment timings have crossed more than 3 hours. Now a patient who is travelling from more than 500 KM is already tired enough. Nobody travels to hospital for leisure. Made the patient wait empty stomach for more than 3 hours which caused massive acidity reflux. The front desk management should follow the token system and shouldn't let anyone enter until their turn has come. I observed that patients were being sent inside randomly, which was the reason behind major delay. Very much disappointed.

featured_reviews.name: Dharmista Poojary
featured_reviews.review_text: Dr.Amita nene is very very very wonderful and very talented person she solved my health issues in just 8days...I am very greatful to her, in another words i can said she saved my life

featured_reviews.name: Swati Nadkarni
featured_reviews.review_text: It’s absolutely pathetic. The hospital insist upon buying medicines from the in-house pharmacy shop who deliver you the medicines as per their convenience. They make you wait nearly for half an hour in the shop saying they are busy. God save the patients depending on the medication from this Pharmacy!
